title: Gun Control
rootClaim: Strict gun control laws should be implemented globally to significantly reduce gun-related violence, homicides, and mass shootings.

branches.text: Widespread firearm availability directly correlates with higher national rates of gun homicides, accidental deaths, and suicides.

children.text: Australia's 1996 National Firearms Agreement resulted in immediate, long-term reductions in firearm homicides and completely eliminated mass shootings for over two decades.
Global homicide rates were already experiencing a secular decline during that decade regardless of specific gun policy interventions.
Universal background checks and mandatory waiting periods prevent impulsive acts of violent crime, lethal domestic abuse, and firearm suicides.

branches.text: Restricting high-capacity magazines and assault-style weapons drastically reduces the casualty rate during mass shooting events.

children.text: Mass shootings involving semi-automatic rifles equipped with large-capacity magazines result in 62% more deaths and twice as many injuries compared to non-assault weapons.

branches.text: The fundamental human right to self-defense requires law-abiding citizens to maintain access to effective, modern firearms.

children.text: Defensive Gun Uses (DGUs) occur hundreds of thousands of times per year in the US, protecting innocent citizens from violent crime.
Surveys estimating high DGU figures suffer from extreme self-reporting bias, false positives, and over-representation of illegal gun uses.
Strict regulations disarm law-abiding citizens while criminals continue to obtain illegal weapons on the black market.

branches.text: An armed populace serves as a vital constitutional check against potential government tyranny and authoritarian overreach.

children.text: Modern state military capabilities render civilian small arms obsolete as a defense against state tyranny.

definitions.description: The defensive use of a firearm to protect oneself or others against active criminal threats.
A policy requiring background checks for all gun purchases, including private transactions and sales at gun shows.
Extreme Risk Protection Orders that allow police or family members to petition a state court to temporarily remove firearms from individuals at high risk of harming themselves or others.
